findings.title: Missing `key` prop on `GrafanaRuleListItem` in filtered rules list
findings.body: When replacing `<GrafanaRuleLoader>` with `<GrafanaRuleListItem>` inside `rules.map(...)`, the `key={key}` prop was removed. Without a React `key` on elements rendered in an array, React will log a warning and cannot track item identity across list updates and infinite-scroll batches, which can cause state/DOM mismatches and unnecessary re-renders.

findings.title: Silence, Pause, and Delete actions are broken or missing for Grafana rules in the list view
findings.body:
In the new list view (`GrafanaGroupLoader` and `FilterView`), `GrafanaRuleListItem` renders `<RuleActionsButtons promRule={rule} groupIdentifier={groupIdentifier} compact />` without passing `rule` (the `RulerRuleDTO`). However:

1. In `RuleActionsButtons.V2.tsx` (line 104), `SilenceGrafanaRuleDrawer` is gated on `rulerRuleType.grafana.alertingRule(rule) && showSilenceDrawer`. Even though `AlertRuleMenu` now shows the "Silence notifications" menu item based on `promRule` abilities, clicking it sets `showSilenceDrawer(true)` and nothing opens because `rule` is `undefined`.
2. In `AlertRuleMenu.tsx` (lines 123 and 165), the Pause menu item (`canPause && rulerRuleType.grafana.rule(rulerRule)`) and the Delete menu item (`canDelete && rulerRule`) still require `rulerRule` to be defined, despite computing `grafanaPauseAbility` and `grafanaDeleteAbility` from `promRule`. As a result, Grafana rules in the list view can no longer be paused or deleted from the menu.

findings.title: Federated rules check removed in `useAllAlertRuleAbilities`, allowing edit/delete on federated rule groups
findings.body: `useAllAlertRuleAbilities(rule: CombinedRule)` was refactored to delegate to `useAllRulerRuleAbilities(rule.rulerRule, groupIdentifierV2)`. Previously, `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` computed `const isFederated = isFederatedRuleGroup(rule.group);`, which marked rules in federated Mimir/Loki rule groups (`source_tenants`) as immutable (`immutableRule = true`), disabling Update and Delete. `useAllRulerRuleAbilities` hardcodes `const isFederated = false;`, so callers of `useAlertRuleAbility` / `useAlertRuleAbilities` / `useAllAlertRuleAbilities` will now treat federated rules as editable and removable.

findings.title: Silence ability for `GrafanaPromRuleDTO` ignores folder loading and missing folder state
findings.body: In `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities`, `AlertRuleAction.Silence` is set to `[silenceSupported, canSilenceInFolder && isAlertingRule]`. Unlike `useCanSilence` (lines 576-578), which returns `[false, false]` while `folderIsLoading || !folder` or when `!rule`, `useAllGrafanaPromRuleAbilities` does not check `loading` or whether the folder exists. For a user with global `AlertingInstanceCreate` permission (`hasGlobalSilencePermission === true`), `canSilenceInFolder` is immediately `true` even while the folder is still loading or if the folder fails to load.
